text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight, hello there~.
Hello, hello. Please take care of me~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let me introduce myself properly.
Um, I'm Lucky Lilac, and—
choice_data_list: Thank you so very much~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Too fast, too fast, too fast!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why are you wrapping things up before even introducing yourself?!
Are you really gonna leave without even saying hello?!
choice_data_list: Sorry, sorry, I was aiming to break the record...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: An ejection!?
choice_data_list: Heavy favorite Impatient Trainer takes a decisive victory!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Oh yeah, when you win, raise your hand a little
and give a big smile to all the fans~."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, no! Why am I acting all graceful
and giving out fan service right now?!"
choice_data_list: I tried to emulate your elegance, Luck, but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, aren't you quite the smooth talker~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...*Ahem*. Well now, allow me to reintroduce him.
This hasty fella right here is my Trainer~!
choice_data_list: Hello, I'm Curren's Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's barely nine characters, which kinda pisses me off~.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...So. The two of us are about to take on
the Twinkle Series together, but—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
How will the first day turn out, I wonder?
Let's go have a little look-see~.
choice_data_list: Okay! We'll see what happens after the commercial!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: There are no commercials!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: âAnd so, our three-year journey taking on the Twinkle Series alongside Lucky Lilac finally begins...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the first day. Fired up and ready to go,
I headed to the training track where Lucky Lilac was waiting—

text_block_list.name: Lara's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I heard the date for your debut race is set!
Congrats~!

text_block_list.name: Lara's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
I know for sure you'll do amazing even after your debut, Lala-chan!
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone.
I'm happy to hear that. But—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We've only just caught sight of the gate.
I intend to work hard from here, one step at a time, so I can make a proper start.

text_block_list.name: Lara's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! That's our Lala! So mature and cool~!

text_block_list.name: Lara's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! If it were me and my debut got decided,
I'd definitely be way more thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufuâ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I mean, honestly, I'm super excited though?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's the stage I've dreamed of ever since I learned about racing.
How could I not be totally fired up?!)
choice_data_list: —Sorry to keep you waiting, Luck!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Good work today.
I'm lookin' forward to workin' with ya again from here on out.
choice_data_list: Yeah, same here! Looking forward to working with you!
Yeah, looking forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Lara's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'll be taking our leave now!
Good luck with your training~!
choice_data_list: ...Looks like you've got a lot of people cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored. I'll have to run in a way
that lives up to those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Since today is day one,
we should start by reviewing our goals... right?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I want to hear again what you're aiming for
Yeah. Once again, I'd like to hear what you're aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...What I'm aimin' for is to be the star attraction of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent running style, painting the hearts of all who watch with emotion,
never failing to captivate them...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of Umamusume I want to become.
...For example—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Like Orfevre-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The "Tyrant," Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 7th Classic Triple Crown Umamusume in history,
having won every single race: the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With 6 total Gâ  victories,
she left behind an incredible legacy, including
placing 2nd two years in a row at the world-renowned Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is one of the Umamusume who shone brilliantly
and became a true legend in racing history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before signing her trainer contract, Lucky Lilac used to constantly challenge Orfevre to races in an attempt to get her running recognized...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is how much Orfevre serves as a role model
and a figure of admiration for Lucky Lilac—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And precisely because I have such a clear aspiration,
there is something I must confirm with her."
choice_data_list: Do you want to follow the same path as Orfe, Luck?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...There are two main routes in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One is the "Classic Triple Crown Route," running with the primary goals of the Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The other path, in contrast, is the 'Triple Tiara Route', targeting the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That earlier question to Lucky Lilac was asking
which of those two paths she intended to pursue.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Orfe-san is certainly the person who could be called my origin.
However—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That brilliance, that intensity, that strength...
they are things only she could ever display...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I believe I have my own way of blooming,
and my own way of being a star."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The ones who graced the Tiara route
combined strength, beauty, and brilliance
in their running style.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that's the exact image
of the star I'm striving to be, too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That is why I wish to run the Tiara route,
and bloom proudly
as Lucky Lilac.
choice_data_list: Got it. Then let's aim for the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, with our general direction decided, the first day of training began—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Phew...!
choice_data_list: Good work today. You really showed what you're made of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Throughout the entire day, Lucky Lilac
handled every single training session
diligently and flawlessly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer elegance makes me realize her high potential once more.
However, this is far from the extent of her brilliance—
choice_data_list: Let's do one final run to finish things up!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
What distance would you like to set?
choice_data_list: I'm shy, so I need a little more time!
I'm shy, so keep it going just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: Oops, my bad, let's make it 1600m!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Understood~
I'll be on my way, then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...What is... what could...—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (The heck d'you mean, "shy"—?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm not talkin' about emotional distance, damn it!!)
choice_data_list: This is it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An explosive burst of speed cloaked in grace.
That is the very strength of Lucky Lilac
that earned even Orfevre's respect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that power, at that sharpness,
my heart trembles with conviction. She will surely
become the star of the racing world—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—...As expected, Lala.
What a powerful run...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose either!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—...Good grief. Trainer,
are you planning on playing the fool after every single workout?
choice_data_list: Huh!? Just the ending isn't enough!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I didn't say that at all!
Just how desperate are you to play the clown?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu—
choice_data_list: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Let's give it our all from here on out,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. And that's how the first day wrapped up, but...
Man, wasn't it full of youthful innocence?"
choice_data_list: And now, here you are standing and walking...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: What are you, a parent looking at their baby?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...*Ahem*.
Anyway, that's how our days together began—
I wonder what kind of wild rollercoaster is waitin' for us next!
choice_data_list: The story begins now!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ............Wait, you're actually serious for the punchline?!
